name: csponsor-funder-status
description: Ruling 67 of prds/prospect-marketing/rulings.md (10-20-26): a funder carries a status, set by staff in Funder Management and offered as a campaign-list step field (build plan § 7c.3). One enum on CSponsorProfile, stored as typed (custom entity, no prefix). Existing funders start empty; nothing is guessed from dates. Partners already carry partnershipStatus. Handoff: csponsor-funder-status-crm-handoff.md.

fields.name: funderStatus
fields.label: Funder status
fields.tooltipText: Where the funding relationship stands: Prospective (being approached), Active (giving now), Lapsed (stopped giving, may return), Ended (the relationship is over). Set by staff; empty means not set. A campaign list can select funders by it.
